instructions.title: Review the Dust Storm Alert
instructions.message: Open the existing Habitat status display.
instructions.guidance: Read the storm safety guidance and temporary outdoor restriction, then acknowledge it.

instructions.title: Assess Mission Control Systems
instructions.message: Review Mission Control systems and communications screens.
instructions.guidance: Record power, communications, navigation and active warnings. Identify the provenance of each value and label simulated telemetry.

instructions.title: Assess Central Hub Status
instructions.message: Review the existing Central Hub status display.
instructions.guidance: Record section states and available power distribution. Do not alter distribution.

instructions.title: Verify EVA Lockdown
instructions.message: Review access status at the existing Airlock control console.
instructions.guidance: The global EVA policy restricts outdoor access during the active storm. Suit preparation and other shared EVA rules remain in force.

instructions.title: Assess Science Power
instructions.message: Review both the Research Monitoring and Cultivation Environment displays in the Research Lab.
instructions.guidance: Record the visible status from each existing display; after recording one, close its interface and interact with the other display. Preserve the Sol 6 sample, provenance and experiment status. Do not restart the experiment or invent results.

destination.name: Research Monitoring and Cultivation Environment Displays

instructions.activity: Record science/cultivation availability from both existing displays.

instructions.title: Assess Engineering Power
instructions.message: Use the existing Engineering power unit front-end.
instructions.guidance: Record all nine requested fields. Distinguish project telemetry, unavailable data and gameplay simulation. Do not interact with Sol 8 repair triggers.

instructions.title: Submit Storm Impact Report
instructions.message: Submit the final report through the existing Mission Control navigation/report interface after Tasks 1–6 are complete.
instructions.guidance: Successful validation fades Sol 7 sounds, restores emergency lights, ends the storm, restores shared EVA access and persists the post-storm power assessment. Sol 8 is not automatically started.

destination.name: Mission Control Navigation and Report Station

completion.title: Sol 7 Storm Assessment Complete
completion.message: The impact report is validated. Emergency state is cleared; Sol 8 has not been started.

constraints: Use existing trigger and screen mappings only.
Never teleport or change trigger locations.
Do not activate or modify the three reserved Sol 8 repair triggers.
Do not change Sols 1–6 records or progression.
